functional.title: Revision and subtitle import
functional.definition: Create workspace-scoped episode storage, bounded WebVTT parsing, original hashes and previous-target associations. Preserve parsed cue text and millisecond timestamps.

functional.title: Alignment and repair planning
functional.definition: Map old and new cues, record reasons and groups, distinguish retime, edit, insertion and deletion, and offer a manual disambiguation action.

functional.title: Scoped purchase and translation worker
functional.definition: Price the full approved repair window, reserve the cap atomically, dispatch through the chosen Kite-compatible seller and record the rail and independently observed receipt. Keep a local adapter for deterministic contract testing.

functional.title: Terminology and timing checks
functional.definition: Validate numbers, placeholders and glossary terms against the pinned revision. Check cue bounds, unintended overlap and display-time limits. Emit per-cue findings and source offsets.

functional.title: Reviewer workspace
functional.definition: Build accessible timeline navigation, editable target rows, reasoned resolve/reject actions, cost indicators and version-aware saves.

functional.title: Export and billable intervals
functional.definition: Serialize valid UTF-8 WebVTT, ordered cues and a manifest with parent hashes, findings and accepted usage. Calculate billable changed seconds as an interval union.

functional.title: Recovery and studio acceptance
functional.definition: Add an operator queue for unknown charges, artifact retention and a replayable studio demonstration through upload, review, purchase and export.

nonfunctional.title: Replayable evidence
nonfunctional.definition: A reviewer can reproduce the outcome from the exact input revision, actor scope, persisted decision and redacted evidence reference after a process restart.

invariants.title: Revision and subtitle import
invariants.definition: An upload retry with the same identity binds to one revision.

invariants.title: Alignment and repair planning
invariants.definition: A low-confidence match cannot silently carry forward an approved target.

invariants.title: Scoped purchase and translation worker
invariants.definition: A quote or stale plan cannot authorize a new or more expensive order.

invariants.title: Terminology and timing checks
invariants.definition: A translator response alone cannot clear an unresolved required-term finding.

invariants.title: Reviewer workspace
invariants.definition: An approval belongs to one reviewer, one digest and one workspace.

invariants.title: Export and billable intervals
invariants.definition: Export preserves unaffected approved target text; overlapping paid intervals count once.

invariants.title: Recovery and studio acceptance
invariants.definition: Restart and replay cannot double-buy a translation or expose another studio's subtitles.
